title: University Senate Hall
purpose: Universities sector card and academic-governance surfaces.
story: A university senate hall set for convocation — the governing body of a learned institution, its seats awaiting the assembly.
environment: A panelled academic hall, a long table beneath portraits dissolving into shadow, high windows along one side.
architecture: Collegiate gothic interior — a hammer-beam ceiling, carved oak panelling, pointed-arch windows receding into gloom.

people.notes: Two or three robed figures near the far end, seen from behind; no face addressing the camera.

composition: The long table on a strong axis under a falling shaft of light, the carved ceiling rising into deep negative space.
objects: a ceremonial mace on a stand
negativeExtra: any writing in books or scrolls
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette from scene-01.
